_readme: STARTER promo codes. The live list is managed on the admin page (admin-promos.html) once you open it; this file is only the starting set and the backup the site uses if the database can't be reached. kind: 'percent' = percent off the first bill (first month of a monthly plan, one-time service, or first snow visit); 'dollars' = dollars off the first bill. appliesTo: 'bin-valet', 'bin-cleaning', 'snow-removal' (leave empty for any).
